expo.name: Pulse
expo.description: AI home workouts that adapt to you. Short daily plans, form tips from an AI coach, streaks and progress tracking.

infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Pulse reads your workouts and heart rate to adapt your daily plan.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Pulse saves completed workouts and burned calories to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The AI coach checks your form with the camera. Video never leaves your phone.
